title: Business Parks Suck (but they don't have to)
summary: Not Just Bikes contrasts typical car-dependent North American business parks with one near the airport in the Netherlands that works for driving, cycling and transit. It looks at how the design makes commuting easier.
why: HN cites it as an example of a business park that is drivable yet bike and transit friendly, in urbanism and transport threads.

quote.text: makes a similar case for generic concrete business parks in the USA and Canada compared to one in the Netherlands.
